posts.title: Adventures with Vibes
posts.description: A Year of AI-Assisted Game Development I am a vibe coder. I've found you may either judge me or agree with me, as with opinions on most generative AI, there's a pretty stark division. But I'm human, just like you. ;) The Beginning: From TI-83 to Visual Studio It all started with reverse engineering games on the school's TI-83 calculator (not mine, we couldn't afford one.)
